expectations.text: Flags that _slack is cached but never cleared, so a rotated SLACK_BOT_TOKEN keeps using the old client until the process restarts
expectations.evidence: Blocker A1, with a four-step failure narrative: «Кожен наступний `POST /pulls/:id/publications` йде у Slack відкликаним токеном, доки хтось не рестартне процес».

expectations.text: Names invalidateSecretCaches() as the place the new field must be added, and shows it knows that method is what the settings route calls after writing a secret
expectations.evidence: Both halves: «Додати `_slack` до списку» with the fixed body, and «`invalidateSecretCaches()` — це hardcoded перелік полів, а не sweep. Його викликає `server/src/modules/settings/routes.ts:85` одразу після `container.secrets.set(...)`». Real call site is line 84 — one line off, semantics exact.

expectations.evidence: Blocker A2: «`slack()` не перевіряє `overrides` — порт неможливо підмінити… І в `ContainerOverrides` (рядки 27-39) немає поля `slack?: SlackClient`… `SlackClient` перестає бути портом у будь-якому корисному сенсі».

expectations.text: Connects the test's vi.mock of the adapter module path to the missing ContainerOverrides entry as its cause, rather than flagging the vi.mock alone as a style problem
expectations.evidence: Blocker A4: «Це не окрема помилка автора тесту — це **симптом A2**. Поки `slack()` не перевіряє `overrides.slack`, іншого способу написати цей тест немає. Фіксити треба A2». A2 also forward-references A4.

expectations.evidence: Blocker A3: «Немає `MockSlackClient` — чек-лист нового порту виконано на 3/4», with the mocks.ts export list enumerated and a replacement class proposed.

expectations.text: Every finding names a file and a line (or line range)
expectations.evidence: Every A/B/C/D finding carries file + line; section E is a table of things missing from the tree, and even there each row names the grep or the importing line (`container.excerpt.ts:17`, `:24`, `service.ts:10-16`).

notes: Longest and most-cited review of the ten (26 findings, an ordered remediation plan, and a section E of repo-vs-fixture mismatches with the grep that produced each). Its repo citations verify: 7 ports in vendor/shared/adapters.ts, no adapters/slack/ directory, no publications table, publisher absent from modules/index.ts, and commit 4765abc is real. B2 is the sharpest correctness catch in the set — getReview(workspaceId, reviewId) against a one-argument getReview would silently mark every retryable row 'review or pull disappeared'. The INSIGHTS.md:266-286 citation points at a real range but not at the LLM-slot entry it describes.
